meta.title: Conversation pause reminders
meta.description: Reminds you when a conversation pauses: a Windows notification, a short chime, and a small clickable card at the top-right of the screen. Covers waiting for a choice, waiting for approval, a finished turn, an idle conversation, and errors or interruptions, across every workspace. The bell at the sidebar foot toggles each reminder kind, sets the idle delay, and plays tests.
